name: Miner’s Expulsion
body:
School evocation [earth]; Level adept 1, druid 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (pinch of explosive powder)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target natural stone and soil no larger than 10 cu. ft. + 1 cu. ft./level
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude (object), then Reflex negates; see text; Spell Resistance yes (object)

DESCRIPTION

The target volume of stone or soil is split into fine particles with a loud crack, and forcefully ejects metal-bearing ores and gemstones. The particles take up the same amount of space as the original stone or soil.
